8. Thus alſo ſaid God to Noe, and to his ſonnes with him : 0. Be-
hold I wil eſtabliſh my couenant with you, and with vour ſeed after
vou: 1c. and with cuerie liuing ſoule that is with vott, as wel in al
foules as in cattle & beaſts of the earth that are come torth out ot the
atke, and in al beaſts ot. the earth. 11. I wil eſtabliſh tuv couenarit with
you, and al fleſh ſual be no more deſtroyed with the waters ot a floud,
neither ſhal there be trom hence-forth a floud to waſt the earth. 12. And
God ſaid: This is the ſigne of the couenant which I giue between me
and you , and between euerie liuing ſoule, that is with you, tor per-
petual generations : 13. (b) my bow wil I ſet in the clouds, and it ſhal
be the ſigne of a couenant between me and between the earth. 14. And
when I ſhal couer the element with clouds, my bow ſnal appeare in
the clouds : 1t. and I ſhal remember my couenant with vou, and with
euerie liuing ſoule that beareth fleſh: and there ſhal no more be waters
of a floud, to diſtroy al fleſh. 16. And my bow ſhal be in the clouds,
and I ſhal ſee it, and I ſhal remember the eucrlaſting couenant, that
was made bettween God and eucrie liuing ſoule ot al fleſh which is
vpon the earth. 17. And God ſaid to Noe : This ſhal be the ſigne of the
coucnant which I eſtabliſhed between me & al fleſh of the earth. 18.
The fonnes therfore of Noe, that came out ot the arke, were Sem,
Cham, and Iapheth: and Cham he is the tather ot Chanaan, 19. Theſe
three are the ſonnes of Noe : and () ot theſe was al mankind ſpred
ouer the w hole earth.
And Woe a huſbandman began to til the ground, and planted a
vineyard. 21. And drit king ot the wine was made drunke, and
naked in his tabernacle. 22. Which when Cham the tather ot Chanaan
had ſcen, to wit that hie fathers priuities were bare, he told it to his
two brethren abroad. 22. But indeed Sem and Iapheth put a cloake
vpon thcir ſhoulders, and going backward, couered the priuities of
their tather: and their taces were turned away, and they ſaw not their
tathers priuities. 24. And Noe awaking from the wine, when he had
learned what his vonger ſonne had done to him, 25. he ſaid : Curſed
be Chanaan a ſcruant ot ſeruants ſhal he be vnto his brethren. 26. And
he ſaith: Bleſſed be the Lord God ot Sem, Chanaan be his ſtruant. 72.
God enlarge Iapheth, and dwel he in the tabernacles of Sem, and
Chanaan be his ſeruant. 2. And Noe liued after the floud three hun-
dred tittie yeares. 29. And al his dayes were in the whole nyne hundred
fittit veares: and he died.
